title: TypeRight: Spell Checker and Autocomplete
context: Keyboards and search boxes autocomplete as you type and suggest corrections, mixing sorted search with string algorithms.
input: Sorted dictionary of words; typed words; letter frequencies.

milestones.title: Letter frequencies
milestones.requirement: Count letters (int[26]); most frequent letter in a text.

milestones.title: Edit distance
milestones.requirement: Minimum insertions, deletions and replacements turning a typo into a word (memo table).

milestones.title: Merge two dictionaries
milestones.requirement: Merge the sorted base dictionary with a user’s sorted custom words.

milestones.title: Similarity score
milestones.requirement: LCS length between two words as a similarity score.

milestones.title: Autocomplete range
milestones.requirement: Words with a prefix form one block: two lower bounds.
